blocks.text: A vDPO engagement does not transfer the organization’s legal accountability
Is a vDPO the same as appointing a formal DPO?
Not automatically
Can a vDPO work with our internal legal, security and compliance teams?
Yes
How much support do we receive each month?
The cadence and capacity are defined during scoping based on risk, processing complexity
Does the vDPO make business decisions for us?
The vDPO provides independent advice and monitoring where applicable
